meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将复杂目标拆解成有依据的步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对复杂目标不知如何拆分
copy.tagline_en: Break down complex goals into evidence-based steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you struggle to break down complex goals

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先把目标登记成计划，再把任务拆成极小的步骤逐条推进，每步都要留下可查证据；改代码、测试或审查会派子代理去做，完成才提交成果。
howto.when: 当你说出“ulw-loop”“ulw”等关键词，或要求做证据导向、带人工检查的长期任务时触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 把数据库迁移拆成小步骤，逐步执行并记录证据。
say.note: 它会先登记目标，再按步骤分派并留证据。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 做证据导向修复：定位登录报错，每步都留检查记录。
say.note: 会派子代理改代码、跑测试并提交验证过的成果。

say.text: 启动 ulw-loop，把“上线新 API”拆成原子步骤并逐项验收。
say.note: 按人工质检流程走，完成才标记为结束。

howto.what_en: With it, Claude breaks work into tiny registered steps, requires evidence for each, delegates code/test/QA to subagents, and commits verified units with evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions “ulw-loop”, “ulw”, or asks for durable goal execution, evidence-led work, manual QA, or checkpointed long-running delivery.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop to break the DB migration into small steps and record evidence.
say_en.note: It registers the goal first, then advances step by step.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop for an evidence-led fix: find the login bug and log each check.
say_en.note: It spawns subagents for code, tests, and verified commits.

say_en.text: Start ulw-loop and split “launch new API” into atomic steps with checks.
say_en.note: It follows the manual-QA flow and marks done only when verified.
